invariants.name: no literal border widths
invariants.diagnosis: A hairline is the signature weight of this UI, and an inlined [0.5px] opts that edge out of the token layer: it can then only be changed by find-and-replace, and it diverges from Kommands, which reads the same upstream scale. Utilities exist for both weights and all four sides (border-hairline, border-thick, border-{t,r,b,l}-{hairline,thick}), generated into frontend/src/styles/tokens.css from tokens.source.json. A genuinely new weight is a value to add to kollektiv/design/tokens.json, never a literal to inline here. Scoped to borders on purpose: text-[Npx], rounded-[Npx] and the arbitrary sizing literals are separate sweeps still open in the checklist, so a broader pattern would be red on arrival.

generated.diagnosis: A non-empty diff means either frontend/src/styles/tokens.css or tokens.ts was hand-edited, or tokens.source.json was refreshed without regenerating. Both are bugs: the next run reverts the edit, and the underlying value never reaches Kommands.
